The repository shows no articles authored by Reyes. Their most recent advising activity in this repository is recorded in 2026. Through these works, Reyes demonstrates a pattern of supervising qualitative case studies and thematic analyses focused on organizational learning, innovation management, and professional skill sets across the food manufacturing and digital financial service sectors.
